lines.t: If it's true love always leaves, why are you still here?
They all walk away, but you don't disappear
Everyone said love would always fade
Promise forever, and they all walked away
Hands that held me turned into strangers
Every I love you didn't last
They built me up, just to break me fast
I thought this all love was meant to be
Till you showed something different to me
And in the silence I finally hear it
A different kind of love and I feel near it
You've been my love song for so long
Playing in the dark when everything felt wrong
They break hearts but you don't
They might leave but you don't
You're the tune playing in my heart
The melody that keeps me from falling apart
Even when I'm lost inside
You stay right here by my side
I tried to find it in a thousand faces
Chasing love through empty places
Every connection turned into goodbye
Every promise learned how to lie
I feel my heart burn, shaky ground
Till it all came crashing down
But you were there when nothing made sense
Love without conditions, love that won't end
And now I see it clearer than ever
Your love doesn't leave me, it stays forever
You've been my love song for so long
Playing in the dark when everything felt wrong
They break hearts but you don't
They might leave but you won't
You're the tune playing in my heart
The melody that keeps me from falling apart
Even when I'm broken and small
You still catch me when I fall
You don't love like the world does
You don't fade when it gets hard
Every note you sing over me
Feels like healing every scar
You've been my love song for so long
Still singing me back where I belong
They break hearts but you don't own
They might leave but you won't own
You're the tune playing in my heart
The melody that keeps me from falling apart
Even when the night feels long
You've been my love song all along
Thank you.
